tools.name: search_trip_plans
tools.description: Search Triptime AI's ready-made, day-by-day travel itineraries (520+ destinations worldwide) by city or country. Use this when the user asks for a trip plan or itinerary for a destination. Returns matching plans with the number of days, places and a link to open the plan on Triptime AI, plus a link

tools.name: get_trip_plan
tools.description: Get the day-by-day stops (places with coordinates) of a Triptime AI ready-made plan found with search_trip_plans. Shows a route card with a link to open the plan.

tools.name: plan_trip_link
tools.description: Create a link that opens Triptime AI and starts planning a custom day-by-day trip for a destination on a real map. Use when no ready-made plan fits, or when the user wants to edit the plan, see it on a map, share it or use it offline.
